note: Real-audio study script (R1, docs/AUDIO_EVAL.md). Every command in test_commands.json is read aloud in Bangla script: the ones typed in Banglish or English get the Bangla text below (also the WER reference, since bn-BD speech recognition writes Bangla script). Free-form tasks are said in the participant's own words: no WER, but intent, amount and recipient are still checked. Labels are for demo user u1 (Rahima).
